hub.ordersBody: Tsatirani delivery, pickup, ndi payment pa seller aliyense.
hub.recentEmpty: Ma-product omwe muona adzaonekera pano pa device.
hub.addressesBody: Ma-landmark ndi GPS kuti checkout ikhale yofulumira.
hub.helpBody: Malangizo pa ma-order, payment, ndi account.
hub.deviceNote: Zosungidwa ndi recently viewed zimasungidwa pa device iyi. Sizotsekera stock kapena mtengo.
hub.vendorPortalBody: Yang'anani listings, orders, ndi payouts mu vendor portal.

saved.description: Ma-product omwe munasunga. Alipo pa device iyi.
saved.disclaimer: Kusunga chinthu sikutsekera stock kapena mtengo.
saved.emptyBody: Dinani heart pa product kuti musunge pa device iyi.
saved.loadError: Sitinathe kutenga product. Yesaninso kapena chotsani.
saved.signedOutNote: Mutha kusunga popanda kulowa. Lowani kuti muyang'ane ma-order ndi addresses.

recent.description: Mbiri yaifupi ya ma-product otsegulidwa pa device iyi.
recent.privacyNote: Zimasungidwa mubrowser iyi yokha. Sizimafananizidwa. Mutha kuchotsa nthawi ina iliyonse.
recent.emptyBody: Tsegulani tsamba la product kuti lioneke pano.

deliveryConsent.title: Kugawana zambiri ndi a delivery
deliveryConsent.description: Vergeo5 imagwiritsa ntchito ma courier okhala ndi licence pa ma delivery ena. Kuti abweretse order yanu, courier amafuna dzina lanu, nambala ya foni ndi address ya delivery. Timawapatsa pokhapokha mutalola. Pickup sifuna izi.
deliveryConsent.label: Patsani courier dzina langa, foni ndi address kuti abweretse ma order anga
deliveryConsent.grantedAt: Munalola pa {at}. Mungathe kuzimitsa nthawi iliyonse.
deliveryConsent.notGranted: Simunalole. Antchito a Vergeo5 adzabweretsa order okha, kapena adzakufunsani asanagwiritse ntchito courier.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Tithandizeni kukonza Convergeo potilola momwe mumagwiritsira ntchito, mwachitsanzo masamba omwe mumawerenga.
analytics.on: Yayatsidwa: titha kuona masamba omwe mumapitako ndi kuwalumikiza ku akaunti yanu mukalowa. Maulalo amachotsedwa pakatha masiku 30.
analytics.off: Yazimitsidwa: timasunga chiwerengero chopanda dzina chokha, monga kuti anthu angati aona tsamba. Palibe mbiri ya zomwe mwachita, ndipo palibe cholumikizidwa ndi inu.
analytics.gpc: Browser yanu ikutumiza Global Privacy Control, choncho analytics yazimitsidwa. Timalemekeza zomwe browser yanu yasankha.
